label: Weigel–Tyroff inherited copper-stock reuse, ca.1700–1766

relations.note: 1766 imprint styles J. D. Tyroff as heir of the late elder Christoph Weigel.
Primary preface states old coppers were already in the publisher's office and were deliberately reused.

notes: Strong comparator for the Clio/Wappenkalender host-regime hypothesis. It demonstrates a mechanism, not identity of custody path: publisher stock can survive textual change and succession. Exact plate-state continuity must still be shown image by image for any target series.
